title: Takumi Modpack
description: The official modpack for the Takumi Project
body:
# Takumi Modpack
This is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed to enhance the Minecraft experience without changing its core gameplay.

Built around the philosophy of preserving the vanilla spirit of Minecraft, this modpack focuses on improving performance, visual quality, gameplay comfort, and content creation tools. Every addition has been carefully selected to make the game smoother, more immersive, and more enjoyable while maintaining full compatibility with the traditional Minecraft experience.

Whether you're building massive projects, exploring new worlds, playing with friends, recording videos, or streaming your adventures, the pack provides a modern and polished foundation for your gameplay.

## About Takumi Project

Takumi is a SMP with intense focus on building beautilful decorations based on a little bit of internal lore.

The name *Takumi* comes from the Japanese word for **master craftsman**, reflecting the philosophy behind this modpack: carefully refining and improving every aspect of the Minecraft experience through attention to detail and thoughtful design choices.

## Features

### Performance Optimization

Takumi Project includes a collection of optimizations designed to improve frame rates, reduce memory usage, decrease loading times, and provide a more stable gameplay experience.

The objective is simple: allow Minecraft to run as efficiently as possible on a wide variety of hardware configurations without compromising visual quality or gameplay.

### Enhanced Visuals

The pack improves the visual presentation of Minecraft while respecting the original art style that makes the game unique.

World rendering, lighting, animations, textures, and environmental details are refined to create a cleaner and more immersive experience. The result is a world that feels more alive and polished without losing the charm of vanilla Minecraft.

### Quality of Life Improvements

Many small but meaningful improvements have been added to make everyday gameplay more comfortable.

These enhancements streamline common actions, improve accessibility, provide better interface options, and reduce unnecessary frustrations, creating a smoother experience for both new and experienced players.

### Content Creator Tools

The pack is also designed with creators in mind.

The pack includes features that make it easier to record gameplay, create cinematic scenes, capture high-quality screenshots, and produce content for platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, and other social media.

Whether you're creating tutorials, survival series, cinematic showcases, or livestreams, the included tools help you present Minecraft at its best.
